before: While a drawing was selected, text pasted on a selected text box or shape went in before the drawing's anchor run, and inserting a picture was refused.
after: Text pasted on a selected text box replaces the text box story, a shape with no text refuses text with a reason, a picture inserted while editing goes in before the anchor run, and other pastes keep their place before the anchor run.
reason: The paste enters the text box story and replaces its text with the released insert, split, and range-deletion operations or the released fragment-paste path, and the picture uses the released insert-drawing operation. Shared nodes, offsets, operations, and the collaboration format stay unchanged.
